brief.meaningEn: Have enough strength or appeal to continue beyond an initial burst of attention.
brief.meaningZh: 有足夠實力或吸引力，能在短暫熱潮過後繼續發展。
brief.grammar: An idea, trend or project has legs; legs is plural in this figurative use. Popular now does not prove it has legs.
brief.register: Informal media and project discussion; a programme editor judges whether a new format can keep an audience beyond launch week.
brief.boundaryZh: 此片語說持續可行性，不等於現時流行程度；須有後續採用、資源或需求證據。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是說想法真的長了腿，也不能僅憑開幕日擠滿人便斷定可長久。
brief.outcomeZh: 能區分初期注意與較長期維持，指出支持或削弱後者的證據。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 183, row 9; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The new fitness craze is popular, but not every trend has legs.

listening.en: The puzzle club was crowded on launch day, but after ten weeks it still had full tables and volunteer leaders. The organiser thinks the idea has legs.
listening.zh: 益智遊戲社開幕日很熱鬧，十週後座位仍坐滿，並有義工持續帶領。主辦者認為這個構思有持續發展的潛力。
listening.promptZh: has legs 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The club has evidence it can keep going.
options.zh: 社團有證據顯示可持續營運。

options.en: The opening crowd alone showed lasting demand.
options.zh: 單是開幕日的人潮就證明需求長久。

options.en: The club had repeat visitors but no one to lead future sessions.
options.zh: 社團雖有回頭參加者，卻沒有人帶領往後活動。

options.en: Volunteer leaders agreed to help only on launch day.
options.zh: 義工帶領者只答應開幕當天幫忙。

listening.explanationZh: 十週後仍有參與者及帶領者，支持持續發展。

reply.promptEn: Could the neighbourhood repair café continue next year? Six months after opening, residents still book every session, and volunteers have agreed to another year.
reply.promptZh: （社區維修咖啡館明年能繼續嗎？開幕六個月後，居民仍預訂每場活動，義工亦答應再做一年。）

options.en: Demand and volunteer support look durable.
options.zh: 需求和義工支援看來可持續。

options.en: The project has support beyond its first week.
options.zh: 計劃的支援不只限於首週。

options.en: This repair café has legs.
options.zh: 這間維修咖啡館有持續發展的潛力。

options.en: The six-month record supports a longer run.
options.zh: 六個月的紀錄支持較長期運作。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都根據持續預訂與義工承諾判斷可行性。

scene.promptZh: 新播客第一集爆紅後，往後三個月每週都有穩定聽眾及兩名長期製作人。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The podcast may have legs.
options.zh: 這個播客可能有持續發展的潛力。

options.en: The first-day clicks alone establish a lasting audience.
options.zh: 單靠首日點擊就可確立長期聽眾。

options.en: The team has no evidence beyond its first episode.
options.zh: 製作團隊沒有首集以外的證據。

scene.explanationZh: 持續聽眾和製作人提供初期以外的證據。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以判斷新活動 has legs？

options.en: The first day is busy, but there is no later attendance or funding information.
options.zh: 首日人多，卻沒有日後出席或經費資料。

options.en: Attendance remains stable for several months and leaders commit to the next season.
options.zh: 幾個月出席穩定，帶領者承諾下一季繼續。

options.en: A pilot keeps repeat participants and finds a viable budget.
options.zh: 試辦活動有回頭參加者，亦找到可行預算。

contrast.explanationZh: 只看首日熱度，無法判斷能否長期維持。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「今日熱門，這個趨勢一定 has legs。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: A trend has legs only if there is reason to expect it to last beyond the first surge.
options.zh: 潮流要有理由相信能在首波熱度後延續，才可說有持續潛力。

options.en: Any first-week spike guarantees endurance.
options.zh: 首週暴增必定保證長久。

options.en: A trend needs only a large opening crowd to prove endurance.
options.zh: 潮流只需開頭人多，就能證明可持續。

dialogue.explanationZh: 短暫熱度與持續可行性不同。

speaking.en: The reading exchange has legs because borrowers have returned each month and the volunteers have secured another venue.
speaking.zh: 閱讀交換計劃有持續發展的潛力，因為借書者每月回來，義工亦找到下一個場地。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出哪兩項證據支持持續運作。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校園種子交換活動第一週有五十人，三個月後仍每月有四十名回頭參加者，學生會已確保下一學期的場地。用英文說明它有持續潛力，但不保證永久成功。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出首週五十人、三個月後每月四十名回頭參加者、下學期場地已確保；勿保證永久成功。

examples.en: The seed exchange may have legs: after fifty people came in its first week, forty regulars still join each month three months later, and the student council has secured next term’s room.
examples.zh: 種子交換活動可能有持續潛力：首週有五十人，三個月後每月仍有四十名回頭參加者，學生會亦確保了下學期場地。

examples.en: With forty monthly returners three months after its fifty-person launch and a room booked for next term, the seed exchange has legs, although its long-term future is not guaranteed.
examples.zh: 首週五十人參加，三個月後每月仍有四十人回來，且下學期已訂好場地；種子交換活動有持續潛力，但長遠並無保證。

takeaways.en: Have legs means show potential to continue after initial attention.
takeaways.zh: 有持續潛力，指熱潮過後仍有理由相信可延續。

takeaways.en: A trend does not have legs merely because it is popular today.
takeaways.zh: 趨勢今天熱門，不足以證明有長久發展潛力。

brief.meaningEn: Spread quickly and attract strong interest, especially online or across groups.
brief.meaningZh: 迅速傳播並引起大量關注，尤其在網上或不同群體之間。
brief.grammar: An idea, activity or story catches fire; caught fire is past, catching fire progressive. In this figurative sense there is no literal blaze.
brief.register: Informal media commentary; a student describes a short instructional video spreading rapidly beyond its first viewers.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有短時間內快速擴散的線索；慢慢被接受可說 catch on，未必已 catch fire。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是起火，也不保證熱度會長久；它着重突然加速傳開。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據時間與傳播範圍，區分迅速走紅與緩慢普及。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 183, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A new sport can catch fire online.

listening.en: A school posted a thirty-second sign-language clip on Monday. By Wednesday, clubs in twenty towns had shared it, and the idea caught fire online.
listening.zh: 學校星期一發布一段三十秒手語短片；到了星期三，二十個城鎮的社團都分享了它，這個構思在網上迅速走紅。
listening.promptZh: caught fire 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The clip’s idea spread very quickly.
options.zh: 短片中的構思迅速傳開。

options.en: The clip gained interest only gradually over several terms.
options.zh: 短片用了幾個學期才逐漸引起關注。

options.en: It remained inside the first school without wider sharing.
options.zh: 短片只在首間學校流傳，沒有傳到其他地方。

options.en: The clubs planned to share it next year, but none had done so yet.
options.zh: 社團打算明年轉發，但目前沒有社團這樣做。

listening.explanationZh: 兩天內傳到二十個城鎮，屬迅速擴散。

reply.promptEn: Why are so many schools trying the new ten-minute science demo? A teacher uploaded it yesterday; overnight thousands shared it and classes in several districts copied it today.
reply.promptZh: （為何那麼多學校嘗試新的十分鐘科學示範？老師昨天上載片段；一夜間有數千人分享，今天多區班級仿效。）

options.en: The idea spread across districts in a day.
options.zh: 構思在一天內傳遍多區。

options.en: Sharing increased extremely fast.
options.zh: 分享數目增長極快。

options.en: The science demo caught fire online.
options.zh: 科學示範在網上迅速走紅。

options.en: A rapid burst of attention led schools to copy it.
options.zh: 一陣迅速湧現的關注令學校仿效。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指短時間內大量傳播。

scene.promptZh: 一個節水手勢影片昨晚發布，今天已獲一百個青年組織轉發。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The water-saving clip caught fire overnight.
options.zh: 節水短片一夜間迅速走紅。

options.en: The clip has gained only a few viewers over ten years.
options.zh: 短片十年間只增加了少數觀眾。

options.en: The organisations intend to share it next month, but have not yet.
options.zh: 各組織打算下月轉發，但現在還沒有。

scene.explanationZh: 一夜間大量轉發，重點是速度。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 figurative catch fire？

options.en: An activity gains one new member each year for a decade.
options.zh: 活動十年來每年只多一名成員。

options.en: A tutorial is shared by thousands within hours.
options.zh: 教學片段數小時內獲數千人分享。

options.en: A new game reaches many schools in two days.
options.zh: 新遊戲兩天內傳到許多學校。

contrast.explanationZh: 非常緩慢的增長缺乏迅速擴散。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「catch fire 就保證這個活動會永遠熱門。」你怎樣回應？

options.en: Something can catch fire quickly without proving that interest will last.
options.zh: 某事可迅速走紅，但不代表熱度會長久。

options.en: Rapid sharing proves permanent success.
options.zh: 迅速分享證明永久成功。

options.en: The phrase tells us only that the clip was posted online.
options.zh: 這片語只告訴我們短片已上載。

dialogue.explanationZh: 片語強調爆發式傳播，不保證持續性。

speaking.en: The recycling challenge caught fire over the weekend: fifty neighbourhood teams copied the first group’s plan by Sunday.
speaking.zh: 回收挑戰在週末迅速走紅：到星期日已有五十支社區隊伍仿效首隊的計劃。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出短時間內有多少隊伍加入。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名學生星期二分享一段修理舊雨傘的短片，星期四已有三十個社區中心轉發並安排同類工作坊；未有資料證明活動可持續一年。用英文交代傳播速度及未知的長期結果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出星期二發布、星期四三十個中心轉發並辦工作坊、迅速擴散但一年後是否持續未知。

examples.en: The umbrella-repair clip caught fire after Tuesday’s post: by Thursday, thirty community centres had shared it and planned workshops, although nobody yet knows whether the interest will last a year.
examples.zh: 星期二發布後，修理雨傘短片迅速走紅：到星期四，已有三十個社區中心轉發並計劃辦工作坊，但仍未知熱度能否維持一年。

examples.en: Posted on Tuesday, the repair idea caught fire by Thursday when thirty centres shared the video and arranged similar workshops; the rapid spread does not prove year-long demand.
examples.zh: 修理構思星期二發布，星期四便迅速走紅；三十個中心轉發短片並安排類似工作坊，但快速傳播不能證明一年後仍有需求。

takeaways.en: Catch fire means spread or gain attention rapidly.
takeaways.zh: 迅速走紅，指短時間內廣泛傳開或引起大量關注。

takeaways.en: Catching fire says little about how long the popularity will last.
takeaways.zh: 迅速走紅不表示熱度一定持久。
